channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: জিম্বাবুয়ের বিরুদ্ধে ব্যাটারদের ব্যর্থতায় হতাশ তাসকিন
item.description: জিম্বাবুয়ের বিপক্ষে শুরুতে তাসকিন আহমেদের বোলিংয়ে ২৪ রানে ৩ উইকেট হারিয়ে কোণঠাসা হয়ে পড়েছিল সফরকারীরা। সেখান থেকে ঘুরে দাঁড়িয়ে নির্ধারিত ৫০ ওভারে তারা ২৭২ রানের পুঁজি গড়ে তোলে। ম্যাচশেষে বাংলাদেশি এই পেসার জানান, ব্যাটারদের দায়িত্ব নিয়ে দলকে জেতানো প্রয়োজন ছিল।

item.title: Midterm voters encouraged to vote early during US-wide No Kings demonstrations
item.description: Thousands of participants attended events across the United States on Saturday as part of the ongoing No Kings movement. Demonstrators encouraged citizens to submit their midterm election ballots ahead of time. These gatherings build upon two years of previous marches.

item.title: এএফসি চ্যালেঞ্জ লিগে কাদসিয়ার বিপক্ষে হেরেছে ফর্টিস এফসি
item.description: মহাদেশীয় টুর্নামেন্ট এএফসি চ্যালেঞ্জ লিগের অভিষেক ম্যাচে কুয়েতের ক্লাব কাদসিয়ার মুখোমুখি হয় বাংলাদেশের ফর্টিস এফসি। কুয়েতের মোহাম্মদ আল-হামাদ স্টেডিয়ামে অনুষ্ঠিত খেলায় ফর্টিস ৩-০ ব্যবধানে পরাজিত হয়। প্রথমবারের মতো টুর্নামেন্টটিতে অংশ নেওয়া দুই দলের জন্য এটিই ছিল প্রথম গ্রুপ পর্বের লড়াই।

item.title: Manzambi scores winning goal for Aston Villa against Newcastle
item.description: Aston Villa continued their strong recent run of form with a victory over Newcastle United. Johan Manzambi secured the winning goal for his club. The player had previously selected a transfer to Villa Park over an offer from Newcastle.

item.title: Violence breaks out between protesters and riot police in Albanian capital
item.description: Demonstrators targeting the government clashed with riot police in Tirana on Saturday. The violent confrontations persisted throughout the day across Albania's capital city.

item.title: Hundreds detained following nationwide cost of living demonstrations in France
item.description: Over 500,000 citizens participated in rallies against the rising cost of living across French cities. The nationwide demonstrations escalated into disorder, including fires, looting, and violent skirmishes. Authorities arrested hundreds of individuals in connection with the unrest.

item.title: Widespread protests over living costs spread across European nations
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators joined independent rallies in France, Belgium, Portugal, and Italy. The coordinated public pressure targets governments across the European Union concerning inflation and living expenses.

item.title: Commercial supply flow into Gaza halts amid fee demands and inspection requirements
item.description: Commercial shipments have stopped coming into Gaza, heightening concerns over severe supply deficits. Goods imported by local traders typically undergo inspection by the Israeli military prior to entry. Additionally, the ministry asked businesses to pay roughly $3,226 per incoming transport vehicle.

item.title: Alipore Court Restrains Mahua Moitra from Defaming W.B. Chief Secretary
item.description: The Alipore court prohibited MP Mahua Moitra from publishing defamatory remarks about the West Bengal Chief Secretary. She had previously used his images and blamed him for voter data omissions.

item.title: সিজেপি প্রধান অভিজিৎ দিপক শর্ত সাপেক্ষে মুক্তি পেলেন
item.description: শনিবার দিল্লির বিশেষ নির্বাহী ম্যাজিস্ট্রেটের সামনে হাজিরার পর সিজেপি প্রধান অভিজিৎ দিপককে শান্তিবাজারের মুচলেকায় মুক্তি দেওয়া হয়। তবে সংগঠনের দুই মুখপাত্র সৌরভ ও রাঙ্কা এখনো আটক রয়েছেন।

item.title: Meitei Organizations and Alumni Condemn Media Scrutiny of MP Bimol Akoijam
item.description: Various Meitei associations and former students have denounced the media trial facing Congress legislator Bimol Akoijam. Supporters argue that the academic's removal was politically motivated and procedurally improper.

item.title: Unwell Leopard Discovered Near Valparai Passes Away
item.description: A leopard that was located in poor health near a residential property in the Valparai region has died. Authorities had found the animal in a weakened state prior to its death.

item.title: TikTok Permanently Blocks Ad Account Promoting Elon Musk Film
item.description: TikTok has permanently removed an advertising profile linked to a four-hour documentary about Elon Musk. The film continues to face pushback across various social media networks.

item.title: Maharashtra CEO Office Yet to Release Discrepancy and Unmapped Lists
item.description: Officials state that publication of unmapped person lists is ongoing at the ERO level without a set deadline. Meanwhile, the period for submitting claims and objections remains active until October 26.

item.title: Montpellier Defeats Bath in Opening Champions Cup Fixture
item.description: Montpellier secured a victory over Bath during the first weekend of the Champions Cup. They overcame their opponents by scoring 22 unanswered points during the second half.

item.title: Small Enterprises Applaud Revised Vehicle Interception Guidelines
item.description: MSME sectors have expressed approval regarding the recent adjustments made to vehicle checking procedures by Commercial Taxes department officials.

item.title: Bangladesh coastal resort fire claims ten lives
item.description: A blaze at a coastal resort in Bangladesh resulted in ten fatalities. Among the victims were six individuals belonging to a single household.

item.title: Actor Imran Khan ordered to exit India over visa rules
item.description: Mumbai law enforcement ordered American actor Imran Khan to depart India by October 28 due to reported immigration rule violations. This follows his involvement in an October 10 demonstration in Mumbai.

item.title: রমনা কালীমন্দিরে মহাসপ্তমী উদ্‌যাপিত
item.description: রাজধানীর রমনা কালীমন্দিরে ঢাকের বাদ্য ও ধূপের গন্ধে মুখর পরিবেশে মহাসপ্তমী পূজা উদ্‌যাপিত হয়েছে। এ সময় ভক্তরা দেবী দুর্গার কাছে দেশ ও মানুষের জন্য শান্তি ও কল্যাণ প্রার্থনা করেন।

item.title: Ladakh delegations and Home Ministry talks yield no deal
item.description: A full-day discussion in Leh between the Home Ministry and regional factions concluded without an agreement. Participants are scheduled to meet again in New Delhi on October 22.

item.title: Moscow resumes diesel shipments following Trump agreement
item.description: The Kremlin announced the resumption of diesel exports after reaching an arrangement with President Trump. The U.S. leader aims to reduce domestic fuel costs prior to the November 3 midterm polls.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh schools observe Innovation Day for Kalam
item.description: Schools and colleges across Andhra Pradesh marked Innovation Day to honor the memory and contributions of Dr. Kalam. Events were held to celebrate his enduring legacy in education and science.

item.title: Delhi NDMC to close Connaught Place Central Park
item.description: New Delhi's Central Park will be closed on October 16 and 17. The NDMC announced the closure ahead of an upcoming "Lehra do Tiranga" march organized by the CJP.

item.title: APPCB official inspects Srikakulam pharma pollution controls
item.description: The member secretary of the APPCB conducted an evaluation of environmental protection protocols at pharmaceutical facilities located in the Srikakulam region.

item.title: Prime suspect in Nedumbassery crash revisited by police
item.description: Main suspect Suhail Sajeev was escorted to the Nedumbassery collision location for evidence gathering at approximately 10 a.m. The procedure concluded in half an hour.

item.title: Public consultation convened for Nakkapalli private port project
item.description: Local authorities conducted a public consultation regarding the establishment of a new private port in Nakkapalli. Residents and officials discussed the potential impacts of the upcoming greenfield maritime facility.

item.title: Historical automobiles that utilized aerodynamic downforce fans
item.description: Prior to the Tesla Roadster, several vintage vehicles incorporated mechanical fans to generate aerodynamic downforce. This technical approach has a long history in automotive engineering.

item.title: Vikrama Simhapuri University Vice-Chancellor enters elite scientists ranking
item.description: The leader of Vikrama Simhapuri University has achieved international acclaim by securing a spot on the prestigious World's Top 2% Scientists index. This milestone highlights the academic's extensive research contributions.

item.title: YSRCP names Varudu Kalyani mayoral candidate for Visakhapatnam
item.description: The ruling party selected its women's wing state president, Varudu Kalyani, to contest the Vizag mayoral race. She expressed gratitude to the party leader and pledged to meet leadership expectations.

item.title: Bayern Munich defeats RB Leipzig 6-1 as Diaz scores three goals
item.description: Luis Diaz secured a hat-trick and Harry Kane played his 100th Bundesliga match as Bayern Munich defeated RB Leipzig 6-1. The victory propelled Bayern to the summit of the league standings.

item.title: Defense Ministry finalizes major defense procurement deals worth ₹4,106 crore
item.description: The Ministry of Defense contracted domestic manufacturers for the GSAT-7C communications satellite and naval torpedoes valued at ₹4,106 crore. These acquisitions aim to bolster the operational readiness of the Air Force and Navy.

item.title: Manasi and Thulasimathi advance to para-badminton semifinals
item.description: Indian para-badminton players Manasi and Thulasimathi progressed to the semifinal stage of their tournament. Because losing semifinalists secure bronze, this advancement guarantees India a podium finish.

item.title: Madurai High Court orders status reports on Sathaiyar channel restoration
item.description: The High Court instructed the Madurai Collector and Corporation Commissioner to submit progress reports regarding a petition to revive the Sathaiyar channel. The legal directive addresses local water management concerns.

item.title: Documentary explores Theyyam transformation in North Kerala
item.description: Performers in northern Kerala endure extensive rituals and cosmetic preparation to personify divine figures. A short film chronicles Vinu Peruvannan adopting the persona of the deified warrior Kathivanoor Veeran.

item.title: Mysuru Dasara to showcase coastal Karnataka culture
item.description: The upcoming state festival will incorporate traditional Kambala events and floats originating from the coastal districts. The celebration previously brought diverse groups together through shared devotion to the Nava Durgas.

item.title: Demonstrators report police violence during clashes in Albania
item.description: Demonstrators outside the Education Ministry in Albania have charged riot police with excessive force. The street demonstrations escalated into violent physical confrontations between crowds and law enforcement.

item.title: Amruta claims silver medal at Under-23 World Wrestling Championships
item.description: Amruta secured a silver after dropping the final match to Zablotska, who secured a pin while leading 6-0. This finish brings the Indian women's team total to two medals at the global competition.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant addresses law students at NLSIU institution
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Surya Kant delivered remarks at the National Law School of India University. He stated that the practice of law demands significant mental toughness and resilience.

item.title: Rajam prepares for municipal elections after twenty years
item.description: The industrial municipality of Rajam is finally scheduled to hold local government elections. This marks the first time voters will participate in local polls after a hiatus lasting twenty years.

item.title: Karnataka High Court questions delayed caste certificate issuance
item.description: The High Court expressed astonishment that a staff nurse earned a monthly wage of 10,000 rupees for 16 years. Judges demanded answers from officials regarding the prolonged failure to process a caste validity document.

item.title: টেইলর ও আরভিনের ব্যাটে জিম্বাবুয়ের সংগ্রহ ২৭১ রান
item.description: প্রাথমিক ব্যাটিং বিপর্যয়ের পর দলের ইনিংস সামাল দেন টেইলর ও আরভিন। তাদের দেড় শ রানের জুটি জিম্বাবুয়েকে দুই শ একাত্তর রানে পৌঁছে দেয়, যেখানে তাসকিন তিনটি উইকেট লাভ করেন।

item.title: Transfer rumors link Viktor Gyokeres to potential Arsenal exit
item.description: Reports indicate that Viktor Gyokeres is seeking a departure from Arsenal. Meanwhile, other transfer talk suggests Xabi Alonso is monitoring two Barcelona players, and Liverpool is eyeing Felix Nmecha.

item.title: শাহজালাল বিমানবন্দরে লাগেজ ট্র্যাক করতে নতুন ক্যামেরা ও মনিটর চালু
item.description: যাত্রীদের লাগেজের স্বচ্ছতা নিশ্চিত করতে হযরত শাহজালাল আন্তর্জাতিক বিমানবন্দরে ৩২টি সিসি ক্যামেরা এবং ১৮টি মনিটর বসিয়েছে বেসামরিক বিমান চলাচল কর্তৃপক্ষ।

item.title: আওয়ামী লীগ সরকার দিল্লির দাসত্ব করেছে: রুহুল কবির রিজভী
item.description: স্বাধীনতা অর্জনের কথা বলে আওয়ামী লীগ প্রশাসন দিল্লির তাঁবেদারি করেছে বলে মন্তব্য করেছেন বিএনপির জ্যেষ্ঠ যুগ্ম মহাসচিব রুহুল কবির রিজভী। তিনি প্রশ্ন তোলেন, প্রধানমন্ত্রী অন্য রাষ্ট্রে কী উপহার দিচ্ছিলেন যা দেশের মানুষ জানতে পারেনি।

item.title: فرنسا: الاعتداء على مراسلة الجزيرة وسط احتجاجات وأعمال نهب
item.description: تعرضت مراسلة قناة الجزيرة، روزي بيرشارد، للتحرش والضرب على رأسها من قبل متظاهرين كانوا يشاركون في أعمال نهب بمدينة رين الفرنسية.

item.title: Anthropic reports an increasingly senior staff and more meetings
item.description: Anthropic noted that over the past year, its personnel structure shifted toward more experienced employees, alongside an increase in time spent in meetings.

item.title: কেরানীগঞ্জে শিশু নির্যাতন মামলায় আট বছর পর একজনের কারাদণ্ড
item.description: দক্ষিণ কেরানীগঞ্জে ছয় বছরের এক শিশুকে যৌন নিপীড়নের দায়ে কামরুল নামের এক ব্যক্তিকে ১০ বছরের কারাদণ্ড ও ৫০ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা করেছেন আদালত। আট বছর আগে এই মামলা করা হয়েছিল।

item.title: Kolkata stampede: SIT probe ordered, financial support announced
item.description: Following a fatal stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata that claimed at least 19 lives, an SIT led by a sitting judge was formed. The government also pledged financial aid and public jobs for the families.

item.title: কলকাতায় পূজামণ্ডপে পদপিষ্ট হয়ে নারী ও শিশুসহ ১৮ জনের প্রাণহানি
item.description: ভারতের কলকাতার চোরবাগান পূজামণ্ডপে পদদলিত হয়ে নারী ও শিশুসহ মোট ১৮ জন প্রাণ হারিয়েছেন এবং আরও ৩৭ জন জখম হয়েছেন।

item.title: Kolkata stampede claims 19 lives with compensation announced
item.description: A fatal crowd crush in Kolkata resulted in 19 deaths, prompting local leadership to promise government employment and financial relief of 25 lakh rupees to the families.

item.title: West Bengal creates safety committee following deadly pandal crush
item.description: Following a fatal stampede at Chorbagan that claimed 19 lives, the Chief Minister of West Bengal has established an oversight committee to evaluate security measures at Durga Puja festival sites.

item.title: State television in Iran broadcasts alleged Hormuz tanker blast
item.description: Iranian national television has broadcast footage purportedly depicting an oil tanker detonating after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Drone LiDAR discovers hidden Aboriginal rock shelters in Australia
item.description: Using drone LiDAR equipment, researchers identified three unrecorded Aboriginal rock shelters in Australian bushland, working alongside the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation.

item.title: Wirtz stars as Liverpool secures Premier League victory
item.description: Florian Wirtz played a key role as Liverpool secured a Premier League win, though questions persist regarding his tactical fit under manager Andoni Iraola.

item.title: Deadly crush during religious event in northern India
item.description: Police reported that at least 17 individuals died during a festival gathering in north Kolkata, West Bengal, amid heavy rainfall and large crowds.

item.title: Police drop inquiry regarding official's spouse over online post
item.description: Law enforcement stated no further steps will be taken against Sarah Helm, spouse of government adviser Jonathan Powell, concerning her comments about author Sally Rooney.

item.title: বার্সেলোনার বড় জয় ও রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের রেকর্ড ছোঁয়া
item.description: রিয়াল বেতিসকে ৫-২ গোলে হারিয়ে লা লিগায় দুর্দান্ত জয় তুলে নিয়েছে বার্সেলোনা। এই জয়ের মাধ্যমে ৫৮ বছর আগের রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের একটি বিশেষ কীর্তিও স্পর্শ করেছে তারা।

item.title: Trump waives certain Russia sanctions under new legislation
item.description: President Trump has bypassed provisions of a new law designed to penalize Moscow for the war in Ukraine. He stated that enforcing these specific measures would run counter to American national interests.

item.title: Fatal crowd crush during religious gathering in Kolkata
item.description: A crush during a Hindu festival event in Kolkata, India, has resulted in at least 17 fatalities and multiple injuries among attendees.

item.title: Tirana Unrest: Police Use Rubber Bullets Amid Rama Protests
item.description: For five consecutive days, demonstrators and students in Tirana have clashed with law enforcement. The participants are demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama.
